title: BCP: A Lightweight Boundary-Controlled Framework for Online Sign Language Recognition and Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32471v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online sign language recognition (SLR) and translation (SLT) incrementally produce gloss sequences or natural language text from sign video as it arrives, a capability essential for real-time communication and live captioning. However, powerful pretrained offline models cannot be directly deployed in this setting, while existing online methods typically retrain the entire model on simulated streaming prefixes constructed from offline videos, incurring high costs. translated_title: BCP：一种用于在线手语识别与翻译的轻量级边界控制框架
translated_abstract: 在线手语识别（SLR）和手语翻译（SLT）在手语视频到来时增量地生成词汇序列或自然语言文本，这一能力对于实时通信和实时字幕至关重要。然而，强大的预训练离线模型无法直接部署在此场景中，而现有的在线方法通常需要在由离线视频构建的模拟流式前缀上重新训练整个模型，成本高昂。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了边界控制前缀提交（BCP），这是一个统一的轻量级框架，可将预训练的离线方法转换为手语到词汇（S2G）、手语到文本（S2T）以及手语到词汇再到文本（S2G2T）的在线对应方法。具体而言，BCP冻结预训练模型，并引入一个轻量级的边界适配器来决定何时提交结果，该适配器由来自预训练SLR模型的连接主义时序分类（CTC）对齐进行监督，而无需…
tldr: BCP是一个轻量级边界控制框架，通过冻结预训练离线模型并引入由CTC对齐监督的边界适配器，将其高效转换为在线手语识别与翻译方法，避免了昂贵的整体模型重训练。
en_tdlr: BCP is a lightweight boundary-controlled framework that converts pretrained offline sign language recognition and translation models into online counterparts by freezing the model and introducing a boundary adapter supervised by CTC alignments, avoiding costly full retraining.
